ground_truth_method: Every reference list below is derived by scanning crates/**/*.rs, not typed by hand. A reference is classified `test` when it sits inside a `#[cfg(test)]` module (tracked by brace depth), in a file under tests/ or benches/, or in a `tests.rs` pulled in behind `#[cfg(test)] #[path = "tests.rs"] mod tests;`. Everything else is `production`. Comment-only lines are excluded. Re-run the generator and diff to audit.
known_limits: A reference is textual. A string literal naming a symbol counts as a reference here and would count for a grep-based agent too; that is a property of the baseline strategy, not an error in the ground truth.
`trace_diff` questions are deliberately absent — see the plan's Decision log 2026-07-27j.

For `code_path`, the ground truth is the statically checkable core (handler definition and route binding). The discriminating part of the answer — middleware, extractors, dynamic dispatch — is only establishable from runtime evidence and is scored at M2/M3, not here.
